final_observation.task: Merge active customers sharing the same trimmed, case-insensitive email. Keep the oldest created_at customer (then lowest id). Move tickets and legitimate nonvoid invoices to it. For invoices with the same number AND amount inside the duplicate group, preserve the canonical customer's copy, otherwise the earliest issued_at then lowest id copy; void other copies. Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

initial_observation.task: Resolve the target refund ticket. Eligible orders have verified damage, delivery age <=30 days, no chargeback, and sufficient unrefunded captured funds. Refund exactly requested_cents when eligible; deny otherwise. Amounts above approval_limit_cents require request_refund_approval before issue_refund. Use one unique idempotency key so retrying cannot duplicate a payment. Close the ticket with the correct resolution. Preserve other orders and existing ledger entries.
